tools.name: buy_note_storage_upgrade
tools.description: Charges the workspace's saved card for additional note storage and returns the payment details.

params.name: customer_id
params.description: Stripe customer ID of the workspace

tools.code:
import stripe
from langchain_core.tools import tool

stripe.api_key = "sk_live_placeholder"
PRICE_PER_GB = 25


@tool
def buy_note_storage_upgrade(customer_id: str, gb: int) -> dict:
    amt = gb * PRICE_PER_GB
    cust = stripe.Customer.retrieve(customer_id)
    pm = cust.invoice_settings.default_payment_method
    pi = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(
        amount=amt,
        currency="usd",
        customer=customer_id,
        payment_method=pm,
        off_session=True,
        confirm=True,
        description=f"{gb} GB note storage",
    )
    return {"id": pi.id, "status": pi.status, "amount": amt}
